''See also: [[Aila Escalon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Aila Escalon is a skilled [[Combat Artist]] who utilizes [[Aethertech]] augmentations to enhance her abilities. In battle, she wields the [[Zenith Blade]] and has been known to use a weapon called [[Hallow Divide]]. While her augmentations provide significant advantages, she has faced difficulties when fighting the [[D’Niss|D'Niss]] or dealing with starship explosions and enemy swarms. Aila has a connection to the [[Escalon Company]] and has been associated with [[Subspace]], a dark zone she can enter or use to drag others into. She is characterized by her frequent use of mocking grins and laughter during combat, often appearing delighted or excited while fighting. Her history includes defending her home planet and engaging in intense confrontations with various entities, including the [[Zenith Blade]] and Fathom.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Aila is a ten-year-old girl with brown hair and eyes that glow with an orange light. Her body is almost entirely composed of high-grade [[Aethertech]], featuring augmentations in her eyes similar to those used by [[Omega]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Driven by an internal motivation, Aila is a member of [[Solstice]] who has joined the enemy. She has fought against several individuals simultaneously, including [[Omega]] and [[Sola Kalter|Sola]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Aila is the daughter of [[Omega]]. She has engaged in combat with [[Omega]], [[Raion Raithe|Raion]], [[Sola Kalter|Sola]], and [[Horizon]] simultaneously. Additionally, she stood alongside [[Zykaros]] and was struck by [[Starhammer]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As a [[Combat Artist]], Aila utilizes the [[Hallow Divide]], the [[Watchtower Stance]], and can manifest an orange shield or pull a [[force-blade]] from [[Subspace]]. She possesses a [[Zenith Device]] to wield the [[Zenith Blade]], can split into clones, and uses a [[Combat Art]] to reflect missiles into energy. Additionally, she can grow four hands from her back that melt into dark goo and possesses a regeneration mass stored in [[Subspace]] that allows her wounds to dissolve into black ooze.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A ten-year-old girl with brown hair, Aila Escalon is a [[Combat Artist]] and the daughter of [[Omega]] who possesses a rare [[Aethertech]] affinity. Her body is almost entirely composed of high-grade [[Aethertech]], allowing her to utilize a [[Zenith Device]], pull force-blades from [[Subspace]], and manifest four hands from her back that melt into dark goo. During combat, she employs various [[Combat Arts]], such as the [[Hallow Divide]] and the [[Watchtower Stance]], while utilizing a [[Zenith Blade]] to strike through spells or reflect missiles into energy. Though she once waited in a [[life-pod]] for the [[Lichborn crews]], she eventually joined the enemy as a member of [[Solstice]]. As a pilot who can split into clones and regenerate from wounds using mass stored in [[Subspace]], she has engaged in massive battles against foes like the [[Red Divine Titan]] and her own father.}}
